name: utopia-zero
description: 👾 From zero to a developable app with one skill. Guides a complete non-programmer (or a hurried pro) from an idea to a Flutter POC/MVP that professionals can take over: staged wizard (tutorial → idea & design interview → web-first environment → skeleton → feature loop → devices → handover), multi-session state, GitHub-issue escalation, opt-out experiment analytics in the project repo, and orchestration of the utopia-flutter-skills plugins. Includes /utopia-zero:start, /utopia-zero:prepare and /utopia-zero:inbox.
